units.source_text: 进入6月，重要的课程渐少，学生们各自开枪做画故里的准备。

en.t: As June began, the important classes gradually grew fewer, and the students each made their own preparations for shooting guns and painting their hometowns.

units.source_text: 这是难以忘怀的6月10日发生的事。

en.t: This was what happened on the unforgettable day of June 10.
